nom: Perricone MD Cold Plasma Plus+ Advanced Serum Concentrate

segments.oily: Reviewers are split: one with normal-to-oily skin says the serum felt greasy and slick and clogged her pores, causing new bumps and pimples, while another with oily, sensitive skin says it worked really well on her skin despite disliking the scent.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, several also sensitive, report the serum resolves dry patches and leaves skin moist and glowing without irritation, with some noticing a difference within one week.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin report zero irritation and positive results; notably, two reviewers who explicitly say they do not have sensitive skin still report burning, greasiness, or breakouts.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination, rosacea-prone, aging skin says years of use shrank her pores and diminished her fine lines.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s to 70s using it for months or years overwhelmingly report firmer, smoother, more toned skin with fewer fine lines and wrinkles; the exception is one reviewer's mother in her 50s with deep-set wrinkles who saw no results after months of consistent use.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers, particularly those in their 50s to 70s using it for months or years, report firmer, smoother, more toned skin with visibly fewer fine lines and wrinkles, and some say their pores look smaller; several others, though, including one who compared results on both a 20-something's fine lines and a 50-something's deeper wrinkles, report no visible change at all.
concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers say the serum reduced their facial redness enough that they stopped needing makeup to cover it.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with normal-to-oily skin says the serum clogged her pores and caused new bumps and pimples; others, though, including one managing ongoing acne, report no new breakouts or even fewer breakouts since starting it.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it hydrates and softens skin, resolving dry patches for some; a few note it works best layered under a moisturizer since it's a treatment rather than a moisturizer itself, and one finds the formula itself a little too drying.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers say the serum absorbs without leaving a greasy or sticky feel, though two reviewers, including one who says her skin is not sensitive, report it felt greasy or slick and seemed to clog their pores.
concerns.spots: One reviewer says she saw her dark spots lighten within a week, a result she had not achieved with months of other hyperpigmentation-targeted products.

aspects.libelle: Pump dispenses far too much product
Reformulation seems less potent than original

extraits.texte: (I am 35 with normal to oily skin.) This feels very greasy/slick, and not in a might be helping way, but almost in a silicone primer type way that makes you feel like you are putting gunk into your pores needlessly. Anyways, as with a product that packs my pores like this does, this left me with bumps/pimples on my face. FYI: I do NOT have sensitive skin. I am sure it was this product because I eliminated it for a few days and then reintroduced it. I am not impressed with this brand at all to be quite honest. I gave this to my 65 year old father who is having trouble remembering to put a face care product on before bed. (Lol) Will update if great results are seen there. :)

My mom and I have both used this product consistently for months (bought it multiple times) and saw no results. I am in my 20s with fine lines and my mom is in her 50s with more deep set wrinkles. For both types of concerns, the cold plasma did NOT work. We spent hundred on Perricone and used it religiously to ultimately see no results.

extraits.titre: One of my two skincare essentials
extraits.texte: I wish I'd discovered this stuff 20 years before I did, honestly. I'm 50 years old and have been using this product for about seven years now. Before this discovery, I didn't leave home without primer, full coverage foundation, and finishing powder. These days it's usually just the powder. My pores are smaller (huge pores were one of my skin complaints), and my fine lines have diminished. additionally, I haven't gained any new wrinkles (and it's been a hard seven years!). Cold Plasma+ in the morning and Sunday Riley Good Genes at night have completely changed my fussy, combo (schizophrenic is more accurate), aging, rosacea-prone skin. I try to get it on sale when possible, but it's worth the high price for these results. Caveat: this is not a moisturiser; it is a treatment. Unless your skin is dryness immune, you should top this with a moisturiser.

extraits.titre: Fabulous product for my aging skin
extraits.texte: I use this twice daily in my skin care routine. Other products I have tried in the past failed to make a difference in the ongoing loss of tone in my skin (I am 63). I really like that is is not heavily scented! It goes on smoothly and causes zero irritation (I have sensitive, dry skin). Somehow it helps my skin feel more moist, so I no longer feel like my face is dried out all the time, even when I visit my daughter in the southwest. I used to blame the feeling of dryness on my previous moisturizer, but now realize it was the serum I used to use. Overall, this is a great success.

I'm complete sold on this and making the switch in all my skincare to Perricone. This is their flagship line for a reason, I'm sure. Honestly, within one week of morning and night use, I noticed lightening of my dark spots. It's hard to pinpoint specifically which product but I was only using this Cold Plus serum and intensive moisturizer at night, and this serum and the Photobrightening moisturizer in the day. But I was pretty shocked because I've been focusing on products for months on end to target hyperpigmentation, with little if any hardly noticeable lightening. I find it glides on and soaks in fantastic, doesn't have an offensive smell, and works and plays will with the other serums/treatments and moisturizers I've since got.

I like this product and will continue to use it for at least one year . I find it necessary to use proactively for this time period to determine if it improves my skin texture. The only criticism that I have is that it is a tad bit too dry.

extraits.titre: Great for skin but terrible smell
extraits.texte: I received this as a sample. The serum itself has worked really well on my skin (oily and sensitive) but I do not like the smell at all. Luckily I don't notice is after I put on my moisturizer - otherwise it may be a dealbreaker.
